description: `PlayerDataStoreService` owns server-side ProfileStore sessions. `PlayerDataStoreServiceClient` is its read-only client mirror.

PlayerDataStoreServiceClient.luau.description: Client-side mirror of [PlayerDataStoreService]. Receives the full profile as one Squash buffer (`profileLoaded`) and then applies `valueChanged` deltas on top of it. The store is read-only with one exception: [PlayerDataStoreServiceClient.SetSetting] may ask the server to change a setting. Everything else is server-authoritative and has no setter.

Shared/PlayerDataStoreServiceNetwork.lua.description: Replicates player data from [PlayerDataStoreService] to [PlayerDataStoreServiceClient]. On join the server sends that player their whole profile as one buffer (`profileLoaded`, hidden keys blanked) and then streams `valueChanged` deltas. The server never listens to either, so a client firing them does nothing.

Shared/PlayerDataStoreServiceProfile.lua.description: Selects the consuming game's profile contract before PlayerDataStoreService initializes. PlayerDataStoreService defaults to `ProfileData`; feature services such as SaveSlotService may select a more specialized contract in their own `Init` method.

Shared/PlayerDataStoreServiceUtils.luau.description: Player Data Store Service Utils provides the module implementation used by the Playerdatastoreservice package. Public entry points include `getSettingsTemplate`, `PlayerDataStoreServiceUtils.splitValuePath`, `PlayerDataStoreServiceUtils.valuePathsOverlap`, `PlayerDataStoreServiceUtils.readObservableValuePath`, `PlayerDataStoreServiceUtils.writeObservableValuePath`, `PlayerDataStoreServiceUtils.readValuePath`,…
